description: This file declares utility functions related to network interfaces, MAC address and IP address conversions, and platform-specific network interface checks, primarily for Linux.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaceExists
methods.description: Checks if a network interface with the specified name exists.

methods.name: TapInterfacesInUse
methods.description: Returns a set of TAP device names that currently have open file descriptors (Linux-specific).

methods.name: GenerateCorrespondingIpv6ForMac
methods.description: Generates an IPv6 address based on a MAC address.

methods.name: GenerateMobileMacForInstance
methods.description: Generates a MAC address for a mobile network interface based on an index.

methods.name: GenerateEthMacForInstance
methods.description: Generates an Ethernet MAC address based on an index.

methods.name: GenerateWifiMacForInstance
methods.description: Generates a Wi-Fi MAC address based on an index.

methods.name: MacAddressToString
methods.description: Converts a MAC address byte array to a human-readable string.

methods.name: Ipv6ToString
methods.description: Converts an IPv6 address byte array to a human-readable string.
